_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.

api._comment: URL and credentials for the running phasezero-tracker-api-server.

db._comment: PostgreSQL connection — same database used by the PZTrack API server.

nfc._comment: PN532 I²C address. Default is 0x24 for Adafruit breakout with both DIP switches ON.

display._comment: SSD1306 OLED settings. Most common address is 0x3C.
